scope: Input-schema adaptation, observed-contract model selection, complete runtime coverage and software regression checks

python_tests.skip_scope: Existing local HTTPS-certificate/account and prepared-LAN checks require target-computer setup; no setup was bypassed

legacy_with_matching_profile.grounded_model2_comparison: Not applicable: the original advisor uses its original catalogue and output schema

limitations: These are runtime coverage and software checks, not new accuracy/F1 or independent real-world validation.
The v2 export was used in prior model development; replaying it cannot establish new held-out performance.
Missing technique evidence is not proof of benign activity; no grounded recommendation is fabricated.
Unresolved assets and unhealthy sensor evidence remain explicit exclusions/blocks.
Synthetic replay assumptions about sensor health, knowledge timestamps and static control membership are recorded in each v2 coverage report.
The available web dependencies differ from historical backend pins; this is not certification of a different target environment.
Actual browser layout, target-computer TLS/LAN setup, production connectors and control efficacy are outside this verification.
